# Pecan AI

> > Pecan AI is a no-code predictive analytics platform that enables data teams to build and deploy machine learning models without coding, solving critical business problems from customer churn to demand forecasting.

Pecan AI provides an automated, GenAI-powered predictive analytics platform designed for business users and data teams. The platform integrates with major data warehouses like Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery, offering enterprise-grade security and pre-built solutions for common use cases across sales, marketing, operations, and finance.

## Key Topics

- Predictive Analytics
- Machine Learning
